  PROBLEM: The single_pass_lease_holder_exempt lease_check_token subshell sources the full "${lease_check_dir}/gh_helpers.sh" without first running `cd "${lease_check_dir}"`. In the deterministic-skip-merge job, the sparse .codex-freshness-src support checkout lacks scripts/emit_event.sh (review_autofix.yml:1240-1250). gh_helpers.sh:1059-1066 therefore falls back to a cwd-relative `source scripts/emit_event.sh`. The cwd at that point is the PR-head .codex-skip-pr-head checkout (review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh:191-200), so the gate sources a PR-authored file.
  WHY: The path runs whenever active audits reach SECURITY_PASS_MAX_CONCURRENT_AUDITS (default 3) and MERGE_LEASE_ENABLED is set. MERGE_LEASE_ENABLED defaults to true and the last run wired it into the det-skip step at review_autofix.yml:1307. PR shell code then runs with GH_TOKEN=secrets.GH_PAT (review_autofix.yml:1292), which breaks the job's "no PR code runs" trust boundary (review_autofix.yml:1269-1271). Every reviewer rated it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical; confidence ranged 4-5. Every reviewer reported it under both the SECURITY and IMPLICIT-EXECUTION/TRUST-BOUNDARY lenses. The proposed fix is to make `cd "${lease_check_dir}" || { echo unreadable; exit 0; }` the first line of the subshell, mirroring single_pass_inherited_clean:1002.
